newsitem.title: CHINA: China tourism industry grows further in November.
newsitem.headline: China tourism industry grows further in November.

text.p: Tourist arrivals in China totaled 4.36 million last November, up 13.23 percent over the year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Tourist receipts in foreign exchange amounted to $894 million, a year-on-year rise of 19.17 percent, it said, quoting figures by the China National Tourism Administration.
In November, 593,600 foreign tourists visited China, a rise of 10.36 percent, while another 3.5461 million travellers came from Hong Kong and Macau, up 12.96 percent, the figures showed.
There were more than 157,800 visitors from Taiwan, a 38.35 percent jump, the administration said.
The number of visitors from South Korea, Britain and Canada each rose more than 30 percent and those from the United States, Philippines and Australia were up more than 20 percent, it said.
